_about: Skill books (user's decisions, see CLAUDE.md SKILL BOOKS). A book holds PAGES; a page goes on ONE skill of one hero for the rest of the run. kind 'stat' = small numbers (max combat.json books.maxStatPages per skill, may repeat): power (% skill damage, heals, shields, buff size), cooldown (% shorter), windup (% shorter), duration (% longer statuses/buffs/shields the skill gives). kind 'modifier' = changes what the skill does (max books.modifierSlots per skill, no duplicates on one skill): ink (statuses put on every enemy the skill hits; a support skill puts them on the enemy nearest the caster), siphon (% of skill damage heals the caster; supportHealPercent of max health for a support skill), selfApply / squadApply (statuses on the caster / whole squad when the skill goes off), plus the same number fields as stat pages (negative = worse) and windupMultiplier. More modifier fields: allyHeal {count, percentMaxHp} + selfCostPercent (Blood Price), tornado (Excalibur tornado spec, Cyclone), ricochet (share for a second target), aftershock {delayMs, power}, grow {scale, durationMs} (Titan look), purify (debuffs cleansed), roar {radius, taunt, self}, summon {minion, max}, onHitChance {chance, apply} (Concussive), desperate {belowPercent, power}.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.text: +8% skill power (damage, healing, shield or buff size).

lasting.name: Lasting
lasting.text: What the skill gives lasts 15% longer.

venomInk.name: Venom Ink
venomInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Poison.

razorInk.name: Razor Ink
razorInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Bleed.

emberInk.name: Ember Ink
emberInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Burn.

frostInk.name: Frost Ink
frostInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Chill.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.text: 15% of the damage it deals heals the caster (support skill: heals the caster 5% of max health).

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.text: Casting gives the caster a shield of 8% of its max health for 4s.

rally.name: Rally
rally.text: Casting gives the whole squad +10% attack speed for 3s.

hasty.name: Hasty
hasty.text: Cooldown 25% shorter, but skill power 20% lower.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.text: +40% skill power, but the wind-up is twice as long.

huntersInk.name: Hunter's Ink
huntersInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits is Marked for 4s (+15% damage taken from everyone).

bloodPrice.name: Blood Price
bloodPrice.text: Also heals the 2 most hurt allies for 12% of their max health, but costs the caster 6% of its health.

cyclone.name: Cyclone
cyclone.text: A small tornado spins up on the target for 4s and drifts between enemies. Cooldown 30% longer.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.text: A one-target skill also hits 1 more enemy at 50% (a heal or buff on one ally also reaches a second ally at 50%).

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.text: 1 second later a second pulse hits the same targets for 35% (a heal pulses again at 35%).

titan.name: Titan
titan.text: The caster grows 30% bigger for 3s: +20% max health and attack, but 10 less evasion.

purify.name: Purify
purify.text: Casting removes 1 debuff from the caster (a support skill cleans every ally it touches instead).

roar.name: Roar
roar.text: Enemies near the caster are Taunted for 2s and the caster gets +10 defense for 2s. The caster takes those hits.

gravecall.name: Gravecall
gravecall.text: Raises 1 weak skeleton next to the caster that fights until the floor ends. At most 2 page skeletons per hero.

concussive.name: Concussive
concussive.text: Each hit has a 20% chance to Stun for 0.6s (bosses: half as long). Cooldown 15% longer.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.text: +35% skill power, but for 4s after casting the caster takes 15% more damage.

desperate.name: Desperate
desperate.text: +50% skill power while the caster is under 40% health.

blue.name: Skill Book
blue.description: Choose 1 of 3 pages and put it on one hero's skill for the rest of the run.

golden.name: Golden Skill Book
golden.description: A boss's prize: choose 1 of 3 modifier pages for one hero's skill.

dealer.name: Skill Dealer
dealer.description: Choose 1 of 5 pages and put it on one hero's skill for the rest of the run.

pageColors._about: The skill book picture on a page card is recoloured by page type (user, skill icons page): stat pages blue, each modifier tag its own colour. [mid, light, dark] replace the blue book's palette entries 1, 2 and 5 (itemIcons.json skill_book). The golden boss book keeps its gold.
